# Matt Haliski

> A developer's portfolio and technical blog covering full-stack web development, iOS apps, mechanical keyboards, and developer tooling.

Matt Haliski is a software developer specializing in Rails, Swift, and iOS development. The site features his portfolio, technical guides, product reviews, and personal projects alongside commentary on modern software development practices.

## Key Topics

- Ruby on Rails
- iOS Development
- Swift
- Mechanical Keyboards
- VS Code
- Xcode Cloud
- CI/CD
- GitHub
- Linear
- ZSA Keyboards
- Full-Stack Development
- Developer Tools
- Web Development
- SwiftUI

## Core

- [Matt Haliski | I build things on computers](https://matthaliski.com): Homepage introducing Matt Haliski, a developer working with Rails, iOS, and keyboards.
- [About Matt Haliski](https://matthaliski.com/about): Biography of Matt Haliski covering his career journey and background in web development.
- [Work](https://matthaliski.com/work): Portfolio showcasing Matt's projects using Rails, Swift, and full-stack development.

## Blog & Articles

- [Blog](https://matthaliski.com/blog): Blog hub featuring articles on programming, keyboards, iOS development, and personal projects.
- [Blogging into the void](https://matthaliski.com/blog/blogging-into-the-void): Article discussing impact of LLMs and ChatGPT on blogging and technical content.
- [I built a deck!](https://matthaliski.com/blog/i-built-a-deck): Personal story about building a deck using Deckorators materials and construction.

## Developer Guides & Setup

- [VS Code Setup for Ruby on Rails](https://matthaliski.com/blog/vs-code-setup-for-ruby-on-rails): Guide for configuring VS Code for Ruby on Rails development with linting and debugging.
- [CI with Linear, GitHub, and Xcode Cloud](https://matthaliski.com/blog/ci-with-linear-github-and-xcode-cloud): Tutorial on integrating Linear, GitHub, and Xcode Cloud for iOS CI/CD workflows.

## Product Reviews & Hardware

- [ZSA Voyager Review](https://matthaliski.com/blog/zsa-voyager-review): In-depth review of the ZSA Voyager mechanical split keyboard with comparisons.

## Tips & Resources

- [Free Tips](https://matthaliski.com/tips): Collection of practical tips for iPhone, Shortcuts, Apple TV, and daily life hacks.

## Optional

- [Small tokens of gratitude for those who've helped me along my journey.](https://matthaliski.com/thanks): Acknowledgments thanking open-source contributors and software creators.
